rules.description: Plugins must execute in defined order based on executionOrder in registry
Blocking plugins must halt pipeline on failure
Failed blocking plugins require correction and re-run before continuing
Non-blocking plugin failures are logged as warnings only
All plugin outputs must be written to .ai/reports/
Context loader must run before any other plugin
Workflow enforcer must run after all other plugins
Product design must run before any implementation
Architecture audit must pass before backend implementation
Security audit must pass before release
